glosses: Briller d'une lumière vive. Scintiller intensément.

examples.text: Le vainqueur corusquait, défilant dans sa nouvelle armure de parade.
La sorcière corusquait puis éclata d'un feu intense.
the frame of burnished steel that cast a glare
About them round, / A lion now he stalks with fiery glare.

glosses: A call collision; the situation where an incoming call occurs at the same time as an outgoing call.

examples.text: He walked in late, with the teacher glaring at him the whole time.
eye that scorcheth all it glares upon
Thor glared at him with hard coal-black eyes[.]
The sun glared down on the desert sand.
The cavern glares with new-admitted light.

glosses: To be bright and intense, or ostentatiously splendid.

examples.text:
18th century, Alexander Pope, Epistle V to Miss Blount
She glares in balls, front boxes, and the ring.

glosses: To shoot out, or emit, as a dazzling light.

examples.text: Every eye glared lightning, and shot forth pernicious fire.

glosses: smooth and bright or translucent; glary
